### `GET` `/pets`

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Schemas

### Pet

Pet is a pet in the store.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer (int64) | yes | readOnly |
| `name` | string | yes | minLength: `1`, maxLength: `40` |
| `kind` | [Kind](#kind) | yes |  |
| `tag` | string | no |  |
| `born` | string (date) | no |  |
| `diet` | [Diet](#diet) | no |  |

### Kind

Kind is the kind of a pet.

Type: string

enum: `"dog"`, `"cat"`

### Diet

Diet is what a pet eats.

Type: one of [Herbivore](#herbivore), [Carnivore](#carnivore) by `type`

### Herbivore

Herbivore eats plants.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | yes |  |
| `plants` | array of string | no |  |

### Carnivore

Carnivore eats meat.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | yes |  |
| `prey` | string | yes | minLength: `1` |

| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `detail` | string | no |  |

| `photo` | string (binary) | yes |  |
